title: Input symbol via the position function
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $C$ be a configuration on $x$. The symbol read by the input head equals the following option-valued function of its position $p$: it is absent when $p=0$ or $p=|x|+1$, and otherwise it is the Boolean symbol at index $p-1$, defaulting to false if that index is out of range.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
